key.description: The closed-vocabulary limit key (lowercase kebab-case slug; the same string the gate attribute carries).

current.description: Currently-observed usage (best-effort from the matching provider, or 0).

cap.description: Effective numeric cap at the current tier.

description:
One limit's usage against its tier cap. The `current` value comes
from the matching ILimitUsageProvider registered in DI;
when no provider is registered the view reports `0` rather than
refusing to answer, because the gate is the source of truth for
enforcement and the view is read-only.
